summary: No counterexample or gap was found. Singleton supports, tilted two-point supports, empty parity classes, and lower-dimensional embeddings are consistent with the claim. The reflection AM-GM bound, ordered same-parity midpoint bijection, and Jensen/Cauchy-Schwarz chain establish every stated inequality. The saturated lattice chart preserves probabilities, reflected sets, half-tilt coefficients, and F, with exactly 2^n intrinsic parity classes. Both predecessor applications have valid hypotheses and explicit, unchanged normalizations; the scalar/set R collision is explicitly resolved. Rank zero and cube sharpness are correctly verified.
